title: REGRESS SPATIAL MAP OUT OF A METRIC FILE
description: For each regressor, its mean across the surface is subtracted from its data.  Each input map is then regressed against these, and a constant term.  The resulting regressed slopes of all regressors specified with -remove are multiplied with their respective regressor maps, and these are subtracted from the input map.

column.description: select a single column to regress from

remove_column.description: select a column to use, rather than all

remove.description: specify a metric to regress out

keep_column.description: select a column to use, rather than all

keep.description: specify a metric to include in regression, but not remove
